summary: Strategy Inc filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement (Supplement No. 2) to its Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC) annex, an at-the-market program for up to $21.0B of variable-rate perpetual preferred. The filing reflects a Second Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations, effective November 1, 2026, approved at the October 28, 2026 special meeting, changing dividend payment cadence from twice monthly to each business day. STRC trades on Nasdaq; last sale $99.13 on October 30, 2026. No special-situation event; routine shelf takedown mechanics. Watch daily-dividend execution and ATM dilution pace.
